      abounding in groves and frequented by ascetics. In that direction also are
      the rivers Venna and Bhimarathi, both capable of destroying sin and fear,
      and abounding in birds and deer, and graced with abodes of ascetics. In
      that region also, O bull of the Bharata race, is the tirtha of the royal
      ascetic, Nriga viz., the river Payoshni, which is delightful and full of
      waters and visited by Brahmanas. There the illustrious Markandeya, of high
      ascetic merit sang the praises in verse of king Nriga’s line! We have
      heard respecting the sacrificing king Nriga that which really took place
      while he was performing a sacrifice in the excellent tirtha called Varaha
